mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emergency_hospital (external_mng_no, name, address, phone, latitude, longitude, is_24h, is_holiday_open, avg_wait_minutes) VALUES (#{externalMngNo}, #{name}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{is24h}, #{isHolidayOpen}, #{avgWaitMinutes}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), address = VALUES(address), phone = VALUES(phone), latitude = VALUES(latitude), longitude = VALUES(longitude), is_24h = VALUES(is_24h), is_holiday_open = VALUES(is_holiday_open), avg_wait_minutes = VALUES(avg_wait_minutes)
